name: Auburn/FastNoiseLite
description: An extremely portable noise generation library supporting Perlin, Simplex, Value, Cellular, and Domain Warp noise across C#, C++, C, Java, HLSL, GLSL, JavaScript, Rust, and Go from a single header or file. Designed for real-time terrain and texture generation.
score_rationale: The dominant portable noise library with multi-language support and widespread adoption across game engines and graphics pipelines.
summary: Dominant portable noise library supporting 9+ languages and noise types for terrain/texture generation.
